caveats.statement: The wrapper cannot authenticate a malicious replacement of its own already-loaded bytes. This external review supplies the exact replay.py and acceptance-record trust root.

The target rejects static symlink components but uses Path checks followed by read_bytes rather than descriptor-stable O_NOFOLLOW reads. A concurrent local filesystem attacker is outside the campaign replay threat model; this audit uses descriptor-stable reads.

The README command and target child commands omit Python -I and inherit the caller environment. The accepted fresh replay passed both the documented invocation and an isolated-mode invocation under a minimal environment. Adding isolated-mode child launches would improve defense in depth.
